skills.name: adapt-custom-endpoint
skills.description: Use when the user asks to connect a video or image provider using JSON submission followed by polling, or to write, validate, test, or save a custom endpoint definition in ArcReel.

skills.name: edit-video
skills.description: Edit an episode on an editing timeline, then render a final cut or export a Jianying draft as requested. Use when all episode videos are ready and an edit is needed; also use when the user requests changes by clip number (such as “c3 drags”), BGM, final output, a Jianying draft, timeline duplication or renaming, or restoration of an older revision.

skills.name: generate-assets
skills.description: Unified asset generation accepting `--type=character|scene|prop|product`, or scanning all pending resources (missing sheets) and dispatching by type when omitted. Use for character/scene/prop/product image requests, new asset references, or missing *_sheet images.

skills.name: generate-grid
skills.description: Generate storyboard grids when users request grids, grid images, or storyboards using grid assembly. Automatically group by segment_break, choose optimal grid sizes, and generate composites of chained transition frames; split into shot first frames only after user review and agreement.

skills.name: generate-narration-audio
skills.description: Generate per-shot narration audio (TTS) for narration/commentary scripts. Use to fill missing audio during first automatic editing in TTS projects, for user-requested shot/episode narration generation or regeneration, or to complete an interrupted narration batch.

skills.name: generate-storyboard
skills.description: Generate storyboard images for shots. Use when the user asks to generate or preview storyboards, regenerate particular storyboard images, or when script shots lack images. Automatically maintains character and visual continuity.

skills.name: generate-video
skills.description: Generate videos for storyboards or self-contained video units. Use when the user requests video generation or regeneration; supports whole episodes, individual items, and selected batches.

skills.name: video-workflow
skills.description: Workflow entry point for ad/short-film projects. Must use when the user mentions making videos, continuing a project, or checking progress. Triggers include but are not limited to requests to make a product-promotion video, continue, take the next step, or check project progress. Even a brief “continue” or “next step” triggers it whenever the context involves a video project. Do not use for individual asset generation, such as redrawing one storyboard or regenerating one character image; those have dedicated skills.
